snippet.title: Flamecraft - Official Console Announcement Trailer | Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
Flamecraft is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 & XBOX!

Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game full of magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper.

Sign up to our newsletter on the official website: https://monstercouch.com/flamecraft
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/QyV2yKjnjJ
